strict_levels.label: Basic
strict_levels.description: Small or solo projects. Keep blockers focused on missing core setup and invalid contracts.

strict_levels.label: Team
strict_levels.description: Multi-agent or branch/worktree projects. Require shared status discipline and stronger task metadata.

strict_levels.label: Regulated
strict_levels.description: Strict audit-oriented operation. Treat missing evidence, approval, and shared status as release blockers.
